Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Sales & Marketing Apprentice position at Radisson Hotel Group. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in SEO, content, and web design, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your sales and marketing efforts while developing my skills in the hospitality industry.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress websites for clients. I have also developed my own project, mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. These experiences have honed my ability to work with IT systems, find creative solutions, and deliver results.

I am drawn to Radisson's 'Yes I Can!' ethos and commitment to exceptional guest service. I am a hands-on, can-do person who thrives in collaborative environments and is passionate about creating memorable experiences. I am eager to bring my digital marketing skills to the hotel industry and grow within your global team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Radisson Hotel Group.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Sales & Marketing Apprentice position at Radisson Hotel Group. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am eager to bring my skills to the hospitality industry and contribute to your sales and marketing initiatives.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation, all aimed at improving organic visibility and driving traffic. I have also built and maintained client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and the Astra theme, ensuring a seamless user experience. My ability to analyze performance data using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs has allowed me to make data-driven decisions that enhance search rankings and engagement.

Beyond my professional experience, I have developed my own project, mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion. This project involved implementing structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This initiative demonstrates my proactive approach, creativity, and commitment to delivering exceptional results.

I am particularly drawn to Radisson Hotel Group's 'Yes I Can!' service ethos and its focus on creating memorable moments for guests. I believe my can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and passion for learning align perfectly with the values of your team. I am excited about the opportunity to support the sales department, maximize revenue, and contribute to guest satisfaction.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am available to start immediately. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch. I am confident that my technical skills and enthusiasm for hospitality will make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Radisson Hotel Group.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
